note: Cases built from fixtures run through `orb validate --json` (the Rust check): well-formed code, refresh, revoke, userinfo, discovery and connect calls; clients, providers, ops and endpoint mismatches; oauth-authorize, oauth-connection-status and oauth-connection-forget; literal issuer and endpoint URLs against `egress` (default ports, case, schemes, data URLs, clients keyed by provider); and the emit block of the three effects. The collector answer is the HOST_CALLS_COLLECTED the shared collector gives for the same program; the emit-config answer holds the findings Rust reports for each emit object.
